requirement: Concurrent Add site imports in one dsh process keep every site's line in the JSON books and never fail on a shared temp file

oracle.ref: PR #1523 (fix); fix evidence: Production dsh log 20/10/2026: a Joomla import failed at reading_files with ENOENT rename uploads.json.1.tmp -> uploads.json while a WordPress import was uploading parts; uploads.json then held only the other site's entry
oracle.invariant: S1: no call throws; each book holds exactly the sites still remembered; no *.tmp file is left; no 'could not queue import operation result' warning. The same-site sweep removes only the old dump and the new line survives. S2: every reader gets the file's bytes; no *.tmp file is left. S3: one undo answers ok, the other {ok:false, code:'DS_UNDO_USED'}; the manifest is marked reverted; no *.tmp file is left.
